$comment: The configuration axes the config-axis matrix varies. See docs/config-axis-matrix.md. Install axes change what is in node_modules (one CI job each); runtime axes are AXIS_* variables read by fixture/apps/app/vitest.config.mts (several runs per job).

constraints.$comment: The hot runtime is a native-engine pool; under the mock engine the option does nothing.

jest-compat is documented as jestCompatSetup + globals: true (src/jest-compat/transform.ts, docs/migrating-from-jest.md): jestMockTransform hoists jest.mock to a global vi, so without globals a partial mock fails with 'vi is not defined'.

versions.$comment: npm ranges installed for each install-axis value. 'lockfile' means the version packages/vitest-native/package.json pins, so the newest cell is the one every other gate runs.

extraRuns.$comment: Every option at its default: engine and hotRuntime unset (both 'auto'), globals off. What a new project gets. 'auto' may choose the hot runtime by worker headroom (it did locally), so `resolve` judges engine and hot as the engine banner says they resolved (run.mjs); `judgeAs` gives the values the static checks assume. The hot pairs are excluded: they need both files in one worker, and the defaults choose their own worker count.
extraRuns.label: defaults

extraRuns.$comment: The hot runtime with more than one worker, as real suites run it. The hot pairs need both files in one worker, so they are excluded here.
extraRuns.label: hot, 2 workers
